items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: if you want to join him here, that's all right too... they joined us there... Eddie liked my mellophone and he used to feature me on the mellophone

ctx.x: He just didn't want you to go --

No - so, when I was going out the door - he said, hey, kid - come back here - I want to ask you something -- he said, do you know where you can get this fellow on the phone -- and I said - you mean, Niebaur yes, I said - he is going to be Castle Farm; he should be
there now with the band -- so, he said - get him on the phone. So, I got him on the phone. He said - let me talk to him. So I..."Eddie? Wild Bill or Bill DAVISON---"

items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I've got all of them and I've got one other whole American band... all of the old Condon guys - different guys that played with the Condon group.

ctx.x: Yeah - well, I'm just saying that it shows you how a littlething can-- and how these festivals get started; some guy takes a chance on a smaller one and if it's successful, he adds to it - gets it to be a bigger one. Now, the Berne Festival is just as prominent as any - as just as prominent as Nice or the Newport Festival here. Everybody knows it's going to be at a certain time every year and they just pile in there - you won't believe it. So,---
And, each year you get more Condon guys over there - don't you?
Well, this year, I'm going to have all the ones left in the Condon band-- I've got all of them and I've got one other whole American band---
